referenceFunction.generalComment: This dataset describes the production of an internal combustion engine (ICE) for a passenger car. The entries are given per kg engine. The original data has been derived for an ICE of approximately 275kg. The information described in this dataset has been obtained starting from the "Life Cycle Inventory of the Golf A4" made by Schweimer and Levin. The final dataset has been published in Althaus and Gauch: "Vergleichende Oekobilanz der Elektromobilität: Elektromobilität bersus konventionelle Mobilität mit Bio- und fossilen Treibstoffen".; UUID: 29334c85-7935-3a62-b632-82c8c5a593b8
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The dataset takes as input the raw materials and the energy inputs required for the production process and includes the production facility. The dataset returns the finished internal combustion engine as well as the output scrap fractions from the production process.
